turns.question: Over the six weeks from Monday 17 August to Sunday 27 September 2026, which day of the week brought in the most revenue, and how much?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no day-of-week breakdown of revenue, so I cannot say which weekday brought in the most; the closest metrics are Revenue (EUR), which can be read day by day for 17 August to 27 September 2026, and Revenue week-over-week growth, which compares a day with the same weekday a week earlier. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
